entries.def:
προ-κυρόω, -ῶ 
to establish or confirm beforehand: Gal.3.17.†
(AS)

προ-λαμβάνω 
[in LXX: Wis.17.11 א2, Wis.17.17 א2B * ;] 
__1. to take beforehand: with accusative, 1Co.11.21 (but see infr.). 
__2. to be beforehand, anticipate (in cl., with accusative, genitive or dative): with inf. (= cl. φθάνω, see Bl., § 69, 4; Swete, in l), Mrk.14.8. 
__3. to overtake, surprise: pass., Gal.6.1 (on the virtual disappearance of the temporal force of the preposi­tion in this compound here and…

προ-λέγω 
[in LXX: Isa.41.26 (נָגַד hi.) * ;] 
__1. to tell or say before­hand: 2Co.13.2, Gal.5.21, 1Th.3.4 (R, txt.; cf. προεῖπον, but see infr.). 
__2. to declare, tell plainly: 2Co, Ga, 1Th, ll. with (R, mg.; see MM, xxi, and cf. Isa, l.with).†
(AS)

προ-μαρτύρομαι 
to protest beforehand (cf. μαρτύρομαι, and V. Hort, in l): 1Pe.1.11 (elsewhere only in Theod. Met., xiv/AD.).†
(AS)
to practise beforehand : with infinitive, (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

προ-μεριμνάω, -ῶ 
to be anxious beforehand: Mrk.13.11.†
(AS)

προ-μοέω, -ῶ and depon. -έομαι, οῦμαι, 
[in LXX: Dan LXX 11:37 (בִּין), Wis.6.7, al. ;] 
__1. to foresee. 
__2. to provide (RV, take thought for): with accusative of thing(s), καλά, Rom.12.17 (-ούμενοι), 2Co.8.21 (-οῦμεν). 
__3. to provide for (before περί, Wis, l.with): with genitive of person(s), 1Ti.5.8 (-εῖ, WH, mg., -εῖται).†
(AS)

πρόνοια, -ας, ἡ
(πρόνοος, careful) [in LXX: Dan LXX 6:18 (19) Wis.14.3; 17.2, 4Ma.6.1-35 * ;] 
foresight, forethought: Act.24.3 π. ποιεῖσθαι, with genitive (Dem., 546, 6), make provision for, show care for: Rom.13.14.†
(AS)

προ-οράω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: Psa.16.8) (שָׁוָה pi.), I Est.5.63 A * ;] 
to see before (as to place or time): with accusative, Act.21.29. Mid., with accusative, before ἐνώπιόν μου, Act.2.25 (LXX).†
(AS)

προ-ορίζω 
to predetermine, foreordain: with accusative, Rom.8.30 id. and inf., Act.4.28 id. before εἰς, 1Co.2.7, Eph.1.5; with dupl. accusative, Rom.8.26 pass., Eph.1.11.†
(AS)
